description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with organization ID, email, and password. It handles API requests, response parsing, error handling, and encryption of tenant IDs.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email address via an API call.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login using organization ID, email, and password, handling encryption, API request, and response processing.
